# DJMaesen `fps arms` attribution

`fps arms` by [DJMaesen (bumstrum)](https://sketchfab.com/bumstrum), from the
[original Sketchfab listing](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fps-arms-08ec4403a47645d8ad80633abf13d39d),
is modified by the Atomic Acres project and licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The source package is frozen from the public VixidDev/Heatstroke mirror at
commit `96fdc4c94ba6c37786b0af6e8caf44b6cf2913f0`, path
`Game/assets/guns/fists2`. The original `Icosphere` object was removed. Atomic
Acres retargeted the 47-joint source to its 37-bone first-person contract,
collapsed terminal tip joints into weighted distal phalanges, adapted the bind
pose and proportions for a first-person camera, capped sleeve openings,
converted specular-glossiness textures to metallic-roughness PBR, partitioned
the unique source faces into four skinned render batches, and added gameplay
sockets, thirteen action clips, reduced LOD geometry, and deterministic weapon
contact poses.

The licence text is in [LICENSE.txt](./LICENSE.txt). No endorsement by the
original creator is implied.
